summary: Quantumsphere Acquisition Corp filed an 8-K disclosing termination of its merger agreement with Omnivate Global Ltd. and SACH Pte. Ltd., dated October 3, 2025. The Purchaser Parties (Quantumsphere, QUMS Pubco, and SACH Merge Sub) delivered a termination notice on September 1, 2026, after a July 14, 2026 cure notice and 30-day period expired. The merger will not close. The company reserved all rights. No financial terms, premiums, or break fees were disclosed. Watch for potential litigation or claims from SACH and the SPAC's subsequent strategic options.
